title: Self-Reliance
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
dek: Trusting your judgment when belonging to a group rewards conformity.

title: Of the Liberty of Thought and Discussion
author: John Stuart Mill
dek: Mill asks what gives anyone the right to decide which ideas others may hear.

title: Of the Division of Labour
author: Adam Smith
dek: A pin factory shows what specialization changes about work and output.

title: The Broken Window
author: Frédéric Bastiat
dek: A smashed window brings work to the glazier. What happened to the work nobody saw?

title: Feature Visualization
author: Chris Olah, Alexander Mordvintsev, and Ludwig Schubert
dek: What does a neural network look for when it decides what is in an image?

title: Zoom In: An Introduction to Circuits
author: Chris Olah, Nick Cammarata, Ludwig Schubert, Gabriel Goh, Michael Petrov, and Shan Carter
dek: An argument for reading learned neural circuits as small algorithms.

title: Test Campaigns
author: Claude C. Hopkins
dek: The advertising pioneer makes the case for testing with real buyers before going national.

title: Experiments on the Effects of Advertisements
author: Hugo Münsterberg
dek: Early experiments ask why ad size, repetition, and placement affect what people remember.

title: The Laws of Habit
author: William James
dek: What practice moves out of conscious thought, and how to make that work in your favor.

title: Memory
author: Hermann Ebbinghaus
dek: Why some experiences return to mind, and what changes when practice is spaced out.

title: The Relativity of Simultaneity
author: Albert Einstein
dek: Two flashes of lightning, a moving train, and the problem of agreeing on what's happening now.

title: On Light and Colour
author: Isaac Newton
dek: Newton separates sunlight with a prism, puts it back together, and asks what the glass actually changes.
